pool.direction: A storage engine whose concurrent reads and writes expose a durability-ordering bug; crash recovery must replay to an exact prefix without leaking later writes.
A merge/compaction pipeline that corrupts record ordering when a crash lands mid-merge; recovery must resynchronize segment boundaries.
A replication protocol where a lagging replica's recovery ordering diverges from the leader after a restart.
A post-crash index rebuild that silently drops durable entries unless replay ordering is exact.
A knowledge graph where heterogeneous records about the same entity must be reconciled under strict identity rules, with hidden unseen bundles.
Temporal fact conflicts where the correct answer depends on effective-time resolution across overlapping sources.
Derived facts that must be materialized from rules and provenance, with queries that distinguish direct vs inferred knowledge.
Records arriving under drifting schemas that must be normalized into one model before querying.
Clean-room behavioral reimplementation of a different layered binary protocol by black-box probing.
A tool with stacked error-correction layers where byte-level and failure-mode compatibility must be exact.
A streaming transform tool whose chunk boundaries and malformed-input behavior are part of the observable contract.
A parser/decoder that must match exact exit codes and byte layout across a deep matrix of malformed inputs.
A formalization ladder built from sparse axioms where a meaningful lemma dependency graph must be preserved.
A target theorem whose proof requires an exact chain of dependent lemmas and exact type checking.
A proof requiring a carefully ordered induction hierarchy; the verifier bans unproved assumptions and weakened premises.
A formal result in order theory where declaration and namespace preservation matter as much as the proof term.
A high-accuracy nonlinear PDE solve on nontrivial geometry with oracle-only forcing and boundary information.
A solver that must adapt numerical resolution to reach a strict hidden error tolerance without fixed tables.
A physics model whose hidden boundary/forcing regimes are only partially observable at solve time.
A long-time integration where conservation/residual checks reject visually plausible but unstable outputs.
A streaming server whose chunk boundaries corrupt messages; verifier tests mis-segmentation and duplicated/dropped delimiters.
An incremental parser whose state is not reset between turns, leaking tokens across requests.
A serving stack where cancellation or timeout leaves a half-written buffer that corrupts the next response.
A protocol layer where content-length vs chunked framing disagree, breaking downstream JSON parsing.
Hybrid-mode trajectory generation for a different motion family with hidden configurations and mode schedules.
A control outcome whose contact creation/release schedule must satisfy first-principles dynamics checks.
An underactuated balancing task where endpoint and smoothness constraints reject visually plausible fakes.
A task centered on impact/transition handling where torque, friction, and collision constraints are verified from physics.
